posts.author: FrigidGaze
posts.body:
Hiya!
RPG Maker MZ's mapping comes with a manual layer selecting functionality from the buttons you see here:
I believe if you click onto a layer where you're above the shallower water (which you'll know when that layer goes semi transparent) you can then layer the deeper water on top, preventing the shallower water from auto tiling its borders around it.
